definition: [ לָעַט ] verb swallow (greedily) (Late Hebrew id. , Hiph`il stuff cattle with food; Syriac jaw ; compare Arabic speak confusedly, utter indistinct sounds ); — only Hiph`il Imperative masculine singular suffix causat, הַלְעִיטֵנִי Gen 25:30 ( J ) let me swallow , followed by מִן of thing.
